title: The locally constant integer algebra functor is a right adjoint
statement: For profinite spaces in universe u, let L(S) be the opposite commutative ring of locally constant integer-valued functions on S. Then L is a right adjoint. Its left adjoint sends an opposite commutative ring R to the profinite space of connected components of Spec R. The evaluation construction of [lem-weil-pbc-locally-constant-prime-spectrum] gives the Hom equivalence, as proved in the source library.

proof.text: Use the source library’s existing private profiniteLocallyConstantHomEquiv: maps from the component space of Spec R to S correspond to ring maps from locally constant integer functions on S to R. Its already proved inverse laws use localization and evaluation. No copy of the Hom equivalence or its lemmas is made.

Import the original private naturality lemma and Hom equivalence with Lean’s import all. Adjunction.adjunctionOfEquivLeft constructs the left adjoint and adjunction. Package this as the public IsRightAdjoint theorem in the helper module, without copying either proof or modifying the source module. The tower proof installs it locally.
